title: Crew that explores all things paranormal visits 69 News
excerpt: Eric and Mike visited 69 News at Sunrise to share what they're working on.
content:
SALISBURY TWP., Pa. - Whether it is a haunted landmark or a UFO encounter, the Eric Mintel Investigates Team is exploring all things paranormal.

Eric and Mike visited 69 News at Sunrise to share what they're working on.

They've been shooting a lot of videos lately. In one, they did a makeshift seance in Jim Thorpe. He said the crew heard a series of knocks, and no one was in the house, he said.

The spirits were called in, and they came knocking, they said.  

The crew tries to tout themselves as "truth without the gimmicks." They don't use gadgetry, but go in organically and letting things happen.

Sometimes the investigators will do a project as a team, or they will be split up.

They said they talk to witnesses when they are investigating an alleged paranormal encounter.

They note that the Poconos has a rich history, and that residents have wonderful locations in their backyards, such as the Harry Packer Mansion and the Jim Thorpe Visitors Center.
